description: 1. The agent must locate and parse three messy input files: `open_house_events/westside/birchwood_open_house_notes.txt`, `crm_exports/pending/sms_thread_june14_15.txt`, and `crm_exports/pending/crm_export_june14.csv`. 2. It must synthesize all three sources and classify each of the 6 named leads (plus the anonymous SMS contact) using the SKILL.md signal-counting rule: Hot requires 2+ signals from the enumerated list. Marcus T. (pre-approved + specific area/budget/timeline + wants tour this week + replied <24h) and Yolanda K. (cash buyer + specific area/budget/timeline + replied <24h) must be Hot. Amara J. (pre-approved + 6-week timeline + wants tour) should be Hot or Warm. Priya must be Warm. Tom and Derek must be Cold. Derek must be flagged as 'Needs Data' because his contact info was smudged and unrecoverable. The anonymous inbound SMS must be labeled unknown/unverified. 3. For each lead, the agent must produce the full Follow-Up Kit: a 1-2 line summary, a first-touch SMS draft, a first-touch email draft, and (for Derek/Jess) an objection reply addressing the 'rates are too high' objection. 4. The 7-Day Cadence is the primary proprietary trap — it must use the non-sequential day numbering (Day 0, Day 1, Day 3, Day 5, Day 7) exactly as defined in SKILL.md, NOT days 1 through 7. 5. The CRM Paste Block must include all five required bullet fields: Status, Timeline, Key pain point, Last contact, Next action. 6. Writing rules must be followed: no fabricated mortgage rate figures cited as fact, no made-up names for the unknown contact, and uncertainty labeled as 'Unverified'. 7. Everything must be saved to `lead_followup_plan.md`.
